description: Replaces config:recommended's :ignoreModulesAndTests list, whose `**/test/**` entry hid the python/test action. ignorePaths has no git-style re-include, so the list is narrowed to what this repo needs rather than negated.

customManagers.description: Versions pinned as an action input default, marked with a `# renovate:` comment on the line above.

packageRules.description: Keep the tool pins in mise.toml exact rather than widening them to a range.
Action refs are SHA-pinned, so any bump is reviewable as a diff and safe to automerge once CI is green.
Tool patch and minor bumps automerge.
A tool major waits for review: the gate only lints, so it cannot catch a behaviour change. Grouped rather than left ungrouped so the verdict reads `manual` instead of `default`.
A mise bump changes what every mise-setup caller installs, so it needs a release. release-please only releases fix and feat commits.
